body: ## Pull request overview Fixes a TileSet editor UX regression where modifying tile animation parameters could collapse the **Animation** group in the inspector, disrupting editing workflows (notably when adjusting frame counts). **Changes:** - Ensure the **Animation** inspector section stays unfolded when `animation_frames_count` changes (which triggers a property-list refresh). - Correct the emitted `"changed"` signal payload for `animation_frames_count` updates (was incorrectly using `"animation_separation"`). --- 💡 Add a `code-review` agent skill or configure MCP servers for context-aware, tailored reviews. Learn more in the docs.
